_meta.name: Decenza barista brain — starter knowledge base
_meta.purpose: Populated starter data for the perception->cause lexicon, causal lever graph, diagnostic rules, trace signatures, and goal->dial maps. Every fact carries provenance {source_id, tier, confidence, contested, note}. Extend by adding rows, not by rewriting logic.

tiers.T3: community or press (hypothesis / soft number only)

rails: R1 no refractometer: never emit an EY% or TDS% number; reason about direction only
R2 grind scale uncalibrated: reason in relative steps, never microns
R3 no water/PSD assay unless user reports it
R4 one untrained adapting palate: scale confidence with corroboration
R5 grind number is grinder-specific: never transfer between setups
_meta.note: Representative, not exhaustive. Numbers like '2 steps' and '~3-5s' are relative heuristics to be re-anchored per grinder/bean (R2/R5).

descriptors.leading_cause: organic acids; perceived sourness tracks titratable acidity (not pH)

provenance.note: TA predicts sourness better than pH
much 'sour' is channeling not global under-extraction

descriptors.leading_cause: desirable acidity (citric/malic) + citrus retronasal aroma; often intrinsic to light roast/origin
contested_alternatives: same acids read 'sour' if unbalanced by sweetness

provenance.note: bright vs sour is a balance/sweetness judgment, not a different compound

descriptors.leading_cause: chlorogenic-acid lactones (light-med roast) and phenylindanes (dark roast); caffeine minor (~15%, soft)

provenance.note: 'overextraction' largely a myth at normal levels

descriptors.leading_cause: dark-roast pyrolysis products + uneven over-extraction of fines
roast-degradation/pyrolysis volatiles; a roast property largely fixed before brewing
contested_alternatives: over-extraction can amplify but rarely creates it

descriptors.leading_cause: loss of oral lubrication from polyphenol-salivary-protein binding; TACTILE, not a taste

provenance.note: in coffee CGAs INVERSELY related to mouthcoating -> CGA-causes-astringency NOT settled

descriptors.leading_cause: low dissolved-solids concentration (low strength); perceived body tracks TDS
suppressed aromatic clarity: over-extraction, staleness, or acidity buffered by high water alkalinity
uneven extraction: some compounds extracted while others aren't; signature of channeling / wide particle distribution

provenance.note: extraction spectrum: fines over-extract, boulders under-extract

descriptors.leading_cause: high dissolved-solids concentration + colloids/emulsion; often a target not a fault
contested_alternatives: 'body from lipids/fines' is practitioner intuition; T1 supports TDS<->body more than viscosity/lipids

descriptors.leading_cause: high concentration (TDS): a strength axis, independent of extraction
contested_alternatives: users conflate 'strong' (concentration) with 'over-extracted' (flavor) - keep axes separate

descriptors.leading_cause: very low residual sugar (~100 mg/L, below threshold); perceived sweetness largely aroma-driven and rises as bitterness falls
contested_alternatives: not purely aroma - non-volatiles contribute; nose-clips reduce but don't abolish

descriptors.leading_cause: roast-derived Maillard/caramelization aromas + low perceived acidity; a roast/origin + balance property
contested_alternatives: largely bean/roast-determined; extraction tunes balance around it

descriptors.leading_cause: occasionally from very short/uneven extraction (early-extracting salts/acids)
contested_alternatives: rare in a balanced shot; often unbalanced early cut

levers.name: Grind size
levers.moves: extraction (dominant, non-monotonic), strength, evenness, shot time/flow

levers.name: Ratio / yield (g out)
levers.moves: extraction UP and strength DOWN (opposite effects)

provenance.note: little sensory impact at fixed EY 87-93C
practitioners treat as meaningful, esp light roast
many stock PI too short to fully saturate

levers.name: Flow profiling / capped flow
levers.observable_proxy: flow held flat, pressure falls as puck erodes

provenance.note: Rao prefers flow profiling for channel healing
direct-cup benefit of pressure vs flow profiling uncertain
deep WDT ~40% less resistance variance; can't fix grinder PSD
Mg extracts more aggressively than Ca

levers.name: Water carbonate hardness / alkalinity (bicarbonate)
levers.moves: buffers acidity -> flatter/less sour; too high -> chalky

levers.name: Bean freshness (days off roast)
levers.moves: evenness & clarity; very fresh -> CO2 gushing; stale -> fast/flat
levers.observable_proxy: early flow spikes (fresh) or fast flat shot (stale)

levers.name: Roast level (context)
levers.moves: reframes every target: light=higher acidity/harder to extract; dark=more soluble/lower acidity/more bitter
levers.observable_proxy: slightly faster flow at same grind for dark

interactions: past critical fineness extraction FALLS via channeling
longer ratio lowers strength while raising extraction (opposite effects)
effect size CONTESTED; modest at fixed EY, larger across wide range/free EY
dominant evenness lever; cannot fix grinder-level PSD
longer/gentler PI -> better wetting -> less channeling; profile compensates for imperfect prep up to a ceiling
high bicarbonate buffers acidity -> less sour; too high -> chalky/flat
light roast: higher extraction ceiling, harder to extract; dark: extracts easily, lower acidity, bitter sooner
body tracks strength; longer ratio -> more dilute -> thinner

diagnostics.change: grind 2 steps finer, hold dose & ratio
diagnostics.hypothesis: shot runs ~3-5s longer, flow slower; sourness drops, sweetness up
diagnostics.falsifier: if bitter/dry, overshot -> back off 1 step; if time unchanged & still sour, look at temp/water

conditions.trace: jagged / early flow spike / erratic between shots

diagnostics.change: fix puck prep (WDT/level/tamp), re-pull; do NOT just grind finer
diagnostics.hypothesis: trace smooths & repeats; harsh+sour edge drops together
diagnostics.falsifier: if still jagged, suspect grinder PSD or basket, not prep ritual
if no change, temperature was not the driver -> grind finer

provenance.note: effect modest but real; safer than regrinding

diagnostics.likely_cause: inherent light-roast acidity (may not be a fault)
diagnostics.change: ask intent: keep as brightness, or round it -> grind finer / longer ratio / +1-2C
diagnostics.hypothesis: if rounding: acidity softens, sweetness rises
diagnostics.falsifier: if it goes flat/muddy, pushed extraction too far for this bean

diagnostics.change: grind 2 steps coarser, hold dose & ratio
diagnostics.hypothesis: shot runs faster; bitterness drops, clarity up
diagnostics.falsifier: if it turns sour/thin, overshot -> back off 1 step

provenance.note: astringency blamed on over-extraction is typically channeling

diagnostics.change: lower temp and/or coarser and/or shorter ratio
diagnostics.falsifier: if it goes sour/thin, we backed off too far

diagnostics.change: shorten ratio (less water out), hold dose & grind
diagnostics.hypothesis: stronger, fuller cup; extraction roughly held
diagnostics.falsifier: if it turns sour, we also lost extraction -> grind finer

diagnostics.likely_cause: uneven extraction / wide grind distribution / channeling
diagnostics.change: improve prep (deep WDT); if persistent, suspect grinder uniformity
diagnostics.hypothesis: 'missing middle' fills in; sweetness & clarity rise
diagnostics.falsifier: if unchanged after clean prep, it's grinder PSD -> grinder is the limit

diagnostics.likely_cause: high water alkalinity buffering acidity, or staleness, or too-high strength
diagnostics.change: check days-off-roast; if fresh & clean, ask about water (alkalinity) - R3
diagnostics.hypothesis: on softer/lower-alkalinity water, clarity & brightness return
diagnostics.falsifier: if beans are stale, water is not the cause -> fresher beans

diagnostics.change: lengthen ratio slightly (more water) and/or coarsen
diagnostics.falsifier: if it thins out & sours, we went too far

trace_signatures.signature: brief pressure dip/notch mid-ramp that recovers
trace_signatures.meaning: a channel opened and healed; some unevenness, often salvageable
trace_signatures.next_change: improve distribution (WDT/level); not a profile fault

trace_signatures.signature: flow rises higher/faster than pressure should allow; pump fights to hold pressure
trace_signatures.meaning: water escaping via a channel -> simultaneously under & over-extracted; harsh/drying
trace_signatures.next_change: WDT + better distribution; flow-capped step can partially compensate

trace_signatures.signature: early first drops / fast weight gain, gusher-like tail
trace_signatures.next_change: tighten prep first, then grind; cross-check repeatability

provenance.note: community diagnostic; no established numeric threshold - HYPOTHESIS

trace_signatures.signature: flat near-zero pressure while flow runs, then pressure ramps as resistance builds
trace_signatures.next_change: let it complete before the pressure ramp

trace_signatures.signature: pressure/resistance spike right at PI->extraction transition
trace_signatures.next_change: lengthen pre-infusion / add a short pause; don't regrind first

trace_signatures.signature: flow below target & can't climb; pressure pinned high; very slow
trace_signatures.meaning: grind too fine / dose too high; over-extracted or sink shot

trace_signatures.signature: flow jumps to ceiling; pressure never builds / instantly collapses; fast
trace_signatures.meaning: grind too coarse / dose too low; thin, sour, under-extracted

provenance.note: sudden jump to ~3.5 mL/s after pressure peaks

trace_signatures.signature: builds normally, then flow races/gushes near the END under rigid pressure
trace_signatures.meaning: puck erosion - a PROFILE artifact, not a grind fault
trace_signatures.next_change: cap flow in final frame / switch tail to flow profiling

provenance.note: distinguish from grind gusher which races from the start

trace_signatures.signature: flow stalls / slow-to-stabilize right after pre-infusion
trace_signatures.meaning: grind too fine, puck over-compressed, or still saturating
trace_signatures.next_change: coarsen slightly / lighten tamp / lengthen PI

provenance.note: wants flow steady almost immediately after PI

trace_signatures.signature: erratic oscillation in flow AND pressure not tracking the puck
trace_signatures.meaning: likely hardware - time to clean/descale, or scale glitch
trace_signatures.next_change: clean/descale; check scale; rule out before blaming grind

trace_signatures.signature: temperature flat at target all shot

goals.target_region: extraction toward balanced middle; lower bitterness
goals.default_path: if sour: finer/hotter; if bitter: coarser/cooler

roast_conditioned.dark: usually LESS extraction (coarser/cooler/shorter) - already near bitter

goals.target_region: raise extraction or reduce acidity perception
goals.default_path: grind finer / +temp / longer ratio; or raise water alkalinity

roast_conditioned.dark: suspect channeling/under-dose -> fix prep; maybe SHORTER ratio

goals.target_region: lower perceived acidity + fuller body; medium-dark territory
goals.default_path: extraction toward fuller/balanced (finer or longer contact, maybe hotter); shorter ratio

roast_conditioned.light: can only TAME acidity, cannot create chocolate - bean property
roast_conditioned.dark: already in territory; keep balanced, avoid pushing into bitter

goals.target_region: higher STRENGTH (concentration), not necessarily more extraction
goals.default_path: shorten ratio (less water) or raise dose

roast_conditioned.light: can take more extraction with the strength
roast_conditioned.dark: concentrates bitterness - go shorter ratio, not finer

goals.default_path: lengthen ratio (raises extraction, lowers strength); raise dose to hold strength

roast_conditioned.light: tolerates a long ratio (high extraction ceiling)
roast_conditioned.dark: lungo turns bitter fast - pull normal, dilute after (Americano)

goals.target_region: lower strength and/or lower extraction; kill harshness
goals.default_path: wider ratio (weaker) and/or coarser/cooler; verify even prep (harshness often channeling)

roast_conditioned.light: a very light roast may be the wrong bean for 'gentle'

goals.target_region: usually commercial medium-dark, ~9 bar, ~1:2, pro prep
goals.default_path: ask what they liked (sweeter? body? less sour?) -> map to other goals; start 9-bar 1:2, match roast style

roast_conditioned.light: unlikely to be the cafe style; confirm bean
roast_conditioned.dark: match roast; aim for the attribute they valued, not a clone
